title: Black Hat 2013 - OPSEC Failures of Spies
summary: Matthew Cole's Black Hat 2013 talk on operational security failures by CIA operatives. It covers the Abu Omar case and how sloppy tradecraft with cell phones exposed officers through call records and metadata.
why: HN commenters cite it as a compelling demonstration that metadata identifies people, and as a great watch on sloppy CIA tradecraft.

quote.text: This is one of the best videos I have ever seen countering this argument.
